title: Add Docker model profiles and E2E acceptance

context.summary: Complete local MVP ergonomics with explicit Docker model profiles and multimodal E2E acceptance coverage.
context.background: The runtime supports multimodal derived artifacts, but Compose/demo scripts and dry-run acceptance still mostly document the text MVP path.

in: Add Docker Compose profiles for ClamAV and optional local model runners with documented disabled/local/cloud profile behavior.
Add demo profile/config helpers for text, PDF, image, audio and video E2E scenarios.
Extend MVP acceptance dry-run/live script to cover text, PDF, image, audio, video, artifact search, metadata filters, reprocess and disabled/non-blocking modes.
Update seed/demo docs and configuration docs for model profiles.
Update validators for Compose/model profiles and MVP demo acceptance.
out: Implementing real OCR/ASR/vision model servers beyond optional profile placeholders.
Replacing Docker Compose with Kubernetes or release images.

acceptance_criteria: Docker Compose defines clear profiles for ClamAV and optional local model runtime services.
Local disabled mode remains runnable without heavy model services.
Demo/acceptance scripts document and validate text/PDF/image/audio/video paths.
E2E acceptance checks metadata filters, artifact search, reprocess and job status details.
Docker/model profile docs explain disabled, local and cloud provider configuration.

manual_checks: Confirm Compose profiles do not require large model downloads by default.

risks: Heavy local model services should stay optional placeholders/profiles so local disabled mode remains fast.
Live multimodal acceptance uses embedded deterministic fixtures, not real model quality validation.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
